children: The FTSE MIB Index went up by 453 points or 0.88 percent on Thursday to close at 52245 points.
The rise was led by Lottomatica (5.24%), Stellantis N.V. (4.03%) and Azimut Holding (2.77%).
On the downside, the weakerst performers were Brunello Cucinelli (-1.72%), Davide Campari-Milano (-1.69%) and Leonardo SpA (-1.52%).

title: The FTSE MIB Index Closes 0.88% Higher
